## Changes

Describe the final implementation or documentation. For mission/world changes, include the objective, affected area/station IDs, and screenshots or a short recording where useful.

## Verification

List the checks you actually ran and their results. State anything not checked and why. See [Testing](../docs/testing.md).

- [ ] Scope and relevant documentation are updated.
- [ ] DE/EN text and stable answer IDs remain equivalent, or this change has no text impact.
- [ ] Relevant build/tests and manual scenarios pass, or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] Shared state, role separation, 2D access and touch behavior remain correct where affected.
- [ ] Database/session compatibility and asset/dependency licenses have been considered where affected.

## Limitations and release notes

Any remaining limitations, migration requirements, changed contracts, or follow-up work? A documentation-only PR does not need a Worker deployment.
